_note: Sparse Vespers overlay — HTM Boston Psalter rendering of Kathisma I, Section 1 ("Blessed is the Man"). Shares the wording of the Jordanville/HTM-family Psalter; both stem from the Slavonic original with a common editorial tradition.

blessedIsTheMan._note: Same wording as the Jordanville overlay. Closing doxology is sung in two parts — `gloryOnly` then `nowOnly` — each followed by the Alleluia refrain.
verses: Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the impious.
For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous and the way of the impious shall perish.
Serve ye the Lord in fear and rejoice unto him with trembling.
Blessed are all they that trust in Him.
Arise O Lord, save me O my God.
Salvation is of the Lord, and thy blessing is upon thy people.
blessedIsTheMan.gloryOnly: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
blessedIsTheMan.nowOnly: Both now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
